terms.l: The rules that apply when you book an experience through RomeSoMuch.
s: Who we are
RomeSoMuch [ragione sociale] is registered at [indirizzo], VAT number [P.IVA], and can be reached at [email]. These terms govern every booking made through this website.
Booking and confirmation

A booking is complete when you receive our written confirmation by email. Experiences with live availability are confirmed automatically at checkout; all others are requests, which we answer the same day and which become bookings only once confirmed.
Prices and payment
Prices are shown per person or per group, as stated on each experience, and include VAT where applicable. Entry tickets, transfers and meals are included only where the experience says so.
Cancellation

All sales are final unless otherwise noted. Where an experience states its own cancellation terms — on its page and in your confirmation — those terms apply to that booking. If we cancel, for weather, illness or the closure of a site, you choose between a new date and a full refund.
Late arrival and no-show
Meeting points and times are in your confirmation. An experience that has already started cannot be joined late, and a no-show is charged in full.
Your responsibilities

Some experiences involve walking, steps, heat or alcohol. Tell us about mobility needs, allergies or medical conditions when you book, so we can adapt or advise against. Children must be accompanied by an adult.
Liability
We provide the experience with reasonable care and are liable for what we control. We are not liable for third-party closures, strikes, traffic or weather, nor for personal belongings.
Complaints and applicable law
Write to [email] and we answer within [X] working days. Italian law applies, and the courts of Rome have jurisdiction, without prejudice to the mandatory rights of consumers.

privacy.l: What personal data we collect when you book, why, and how long we keep it.
s: Data controller
The controller is RomeSoMuch [ragione sociale], [indirizzo], [email]. For any request about your data, write to that address.
What we collect

Booking data: name, email, phone, date, number of guests and any notes you send us. Payment data is handled by our payment provider — we never see or store card numbers. Technical data: the pages you visit on this site, in aggregate.
Why we use it

To confirm and run your booking (performance of a contract), to answer your messages (legitimate interest), to meet tax and accounting obligations (legal obligation), and — only with your consent — to send you occasional emails about new experiences.
Who else sees it

Only the people who need it to deliver your experience: the guide, chef or driver assigned to you, our booking system provider, our payment provider, and our accountant. We do not sell data and we do not share it for anyone else's marketing.
How long we keep it
Booking records for 10 years, as tax law requires. Enquiries that do not become bookings for 24 months. Consent-based emails until you unsubscribe.
Your rights

You can ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your data, object to processing, and withdraw consent at any time by writing to [email]. You can also complain to the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali.

cookies.l: Which cookies this site sets, what they do, and how to refuse them.
s: What cookies are
Small files stored by your browser. Some are needed for the site to work; others measure how it is used or come from services embedded in the page.
Technical cookies
Always active, no consent needed. They keep your session, your language and the state of the booking form. Deleting them logs you out of an unfinished booking.
Analytics cookies
Used only if you accept them. They tell us which experiences people look at and where they leave the page, in aggregate. They can be refused without losing any function of the site.
Third-party cookies

The booking calendar is provided by Bokun (Tripadvisor group) and sets its own cookies when it loads, so that availability and checkout work. Payment pages set cookies for fraud prevention. These services have their own policies.
Managing your choices
Use the cookie banner to accept or refuse non-essential cookies, and your browser settings to delete cookies already stored. Refusing analytics has no effect on booking.
